Class QuoteBuilderControllerTest

@IsTest()
private class QuoteBuilderControllerTest

Test class for QuoteBuilderController. Validates product search, product creation, product detail retrieval, quote saving with line items, and picklist value retrieval.

    Test Classes

Since:

createProductTest()
Verifies that createProduct creates a Product2 and its PricebookEntry in the standard pricebook, and returns a ProductSearchResult with the correct values.

Verifies that getProductDetails returns the correct product name, unit price, and pricebook entry for a given product Id.

private static void
saveQuoteErrorTest()
Verifies that saveQuote throws an AuraHandledException when the quote data is invalid or missing required fields.
private static void
saveQuoteNoLineItemsTest()
Verifies that saveQuote successfully creates a Quote when an empty line items list is provided.
private static void
saveQuoteTest()
Verifies that saveQuote creates a Quote with two QuoteLineItem records and persists all field values including tax, shipping, and address fields.
private static void
setupTestData()
Creates two Product2 records with standard PricebookEntry records, a test Account, and a test Contact for use across all test methods.
